column1: # Gold morphological evaluation set (demo scale — replace/extend for real decisions).
#   surface_word <TAB> gold_segmentation ('|' between morphs, '-' if none) <TAB> complete (1 = every true
#   boundary in fidel space is annotated; 0 = partial, only listed boundaries are gold) <TAB> root radicals
#   (consonant skeleton as fidels, '-' if not a root-and-pattern item)
# Gold boundaries are annotated ONLY where the morpheme junction falls on a clean fidel boundary.
# Fused junctions (e.g. ቤቱ = ቤት + ኡ, where the vowel suffix merges into the final fidel) cannot be
# expressed in grapheme space; such items are marked complete=0 with only their clean boundaries listed.
